scenarios.name: smoke-turns
scenarios.description: Plain turns over a fan, no echo: a name, a 1.2 s mid-sentence pause, a long question interrupted 1.2 s into Dee's reply, and a memory probe.

scenarios.name: smoke-echo
scenarios.description: Kitchen noise with Dee's own voice fed back at -20 dB / 80 ms through the room IR: two echo-only lines (must not self-trigger), a filler turn, and a barge-in over Dee's echo.

steps.deeSays: Did you know octopuses have three hearts? Two pump blood to the gills, and one pumps it to the rest of the body.

steps.instructions: Answer warmly in two or three sentences.

steps.deeSays: Here is a little poem. The kettle sings, the window hums, and somewhere far a soft rain comes.
